mechanism: Vedolizumab may increase infection risk through gut-selective immunosuppression, and concurrent nephrotoxic gentamicin use increases risk of acute kidney injury which can impair drug clearance and immunosuppression.
action: Monitor renal function baseline and regularly; use gentamicin only if necessary and at appropriate dosing intervals; assess for signs of infection and adjust vedolizumab dosing if renal impairment develops.
